claim_tested: AP5B1 has a discrete C-terminal domain
key_finding: AF-Q2VPB7-F1 ordered segments end at 624; a separate well-ordered module spans 664-870 (pLDDT 85.4) joined by a low-confidence linker 625-663 (pLDDT 53.4); trunk-to-module PAE 27.35 versus 7.01 within the module
context: human Q2VPB7, AlphaFold DB v6 model
confidence_and_limitations: High for domain boundaries. AlphaFold model, not experimental coordinates.

claim_tested: the C-terminal domain is an appendage domain
key_finding: Top structural hits are appendage domains: 1r4x_A gamma-COP ear E=8.1e-8, 1pzd_A gamma-COP ear E=8.8e-7, 5a1u_E COPI triad E=7.9e-7, 2iv9_A AP-2 beta2 ear with Eps15 peptide E=1.8e-6
confidence_and_limitations: High. E-values from the Foldseek web server, 492 hits.

claim_tested: the fold is the platform/sandwich appendage fold
key_finding: TM-score to AP5B1 660-878: 3H1Z 0.684, 2IV8 0.671, 1E42 0.670, 2IV9 0.661, 1KY7 0.648, 2VJ0 0.611, 1R4X 0.564, 1PZD 0.561. Negative control 1UBQ 0.266. Reference pair 2IV9 versus 1R4X 0.456
context: deposited AP-2 and gamma-COP ear structures
confidence_and_limitations: High. All appendage TM-scores exceed 0.5 and exceed the beta2-ear/gamma-COP-ear value. Structure-based sequence identity is only 7.7-12.3%.

claim_tested: the FxxxW platform signature is present
key_finding: The platform signature is conserved: AP5B1 F782-EEL-W786 aligns with alpha F836-FQR-W840 and beta2 F837-LAT-W841
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. The motif is present, but this study finds both residues buried (relative SASA 0.00 and 0.05).

claim_tested: identity is elevated at AP-2 peptide-contact positions
key_finding: Pooled 24/100 (24.0%) at contact positions versus 163/1551 (10.5%) elsewhere, OR 2.72, one-sided p=1.65e-4. Per-site: 1KYU DPF p=0.019, 1KY7 FxDxF p=0.015, 2VJ0 chain Q p=0.036
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Positive, but confounded: the matching residues are buried core positions (F782 0.00, W786 0.05, G851 0.02, V852 0.01).

claim_tested: the steric peptide-transfer test is informative
key_finding: Transferring the 1KY7 peptide between genuine homologues gives 28 clashes <2.2 A (onto 2IV8) and 33 (onto 1E42) versus 21 onto AP5B1; self-transfer gives 0
confidence_and_limitations: High for the conclusion that clash counts at 3-5 A alignment accuracy are an artefact. This test was therefore discarded as evidence.

claim_tested: a conserved ligand surface sits at the canonical sites
key_finding: Surface residues within 8 A of the alpha-ear platform peptide: n=13, mean identity 0.219 versus 0.255 elsewhere, p=0.694. Within 8 A of the beta2 sandwich peptide: n=8, 0.172 versus 0.257, p=0.864
context: 112 AP5B1 orthologs (Foldseek afdb50), metazoa to plants and amoebozoa
confidence_and_limitations: High, given the positive control below. Conservation is computed from a structure-guided alignment, not a curated MSA.

claim_tested: the same test detects known ligand sites
key_finding: AP-2 beta2 ear: IVF sandwich +0.424 p<5e-5, Eps15 sandwich +0.302 p<5e-5, arrestin platform +0.040 p=0.264. AP-2 alpha ear: FxDxF platform +0.102 p=0.022, side site +0.234 p=0.0001
context: 1E42 and 1KY7 with their own ortholog sets (301 and 437 hits)
confidence_and_limitations: High. 4 of 5 known sites recovered, so the AP5B1 negative is interpretable.

claim_tested: any ligand-type conserved surface exists on the AP5B1 ear
key_finding: Best patch: beta2 ear Q756 score 0.817 p=0.0004, 4.6 A from the IVF peptide; alpha ear R905 0.709 p=0.0045, 4.4 A from the FxDxF peptide; AP5B1 D837 0.643 p=0.0302, 22.9 A from the superposed alpha peptide
context: same geometry and smoothing for all three
confidence_and_limitations: High. In both real ears the conservation maximum lands on a ligand site unprompted; in AP5B1 it does not.

claim_tested: the appendage is a flexibly tethered module
key_finding: Full-length 878-residue AP5B1 is modelled only to residue 631 in both entries; 632-878 has no coordinates, while AP5Z1 is 83% modelled, AP5S1 91%, AP5M1 96%
context: human AP-5 bound to SPG11-SPG15, 3.26 A and 3.3 A
confidence_and_limitations: High for the disorder observation. Consistent with ear-like flexible attachment; gives no information on ligand binding.

key_finding: AP-5 is a tetramer of AP5Z1, AP5B1, AP5M1, AP5S1 associated with SPG11 and ZFYVE26; late-endosomal, involved in endosomal transport
confidence_and_limitations: High for complex membership. No mapping of any interaction to the AP5B1 C terminus.

claim_tested: appendage ligand sites can be retained outside AP-1/AP-2
key_finding: The AP-4 beta4 ear binds a [GS]LFXG[ML]X[LV] motif at a conserved hydrophobic surface on the platform fold
confidence_and_limitations: High for AP-4. Shows that retention is possible, which makes the AP5B1 negative a result about AP5B1 rather than about AP-5-era appendages in general.

key_finding: Only MF term on Q2VPB7 is GO:0005515. Pfam PF21589 (690-759) and PF21590 (781-873) split the C terminus into two unnamed domains matching the sandwich and platform subdomains found here
confidence_and_limitations: High. Database state, not evidence of function.
